skills.name: browser-use
skills.description: Research and operate rendered web pages through OpenCorvus Browser tools, including authenticated workflows and visual inspection.

skills.name: computer-use
skills.description: Operate native desktop apps through OpenCorvus Computer tools when the task requires their visible interface.

skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.description: Apply context-aware visual judgment to frontend product design and redesign work. Infer the design language from the accepted brief and evidence, use mature design systems, avoid generic generated-interface patterns, and finish through real rendered-page inspection.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

skills.name: research-report
skills.description: Produce a multi-source research report — comparison matrix, capability survey, market analysis, recommendation document — backed by `websearch` (and `webfetch` only after `websearch` returns a concrete URL). Activate when the deliverable is a markdown report rather than running software, and the work is fundamentally synthesising prose from external sources rather than writing code. Signals — the brief asks for 报告 / 调研 / 对比 / 分析 / 综述 / 功能矩阵 / 评估 / 建议 / report / comparison / matrix / analysis / survey / recommendation; or compares named third-party products / platforms / vendors; or asks for a structured insight + recommendation document. Do NOT activate for code tasks, even when the code happens to consume third-party APIs.

skills.name: work-artifacts
skills.description: Create, inspect, validate, review, and deliver enabled structured Work Artifacts through the single OpenCorvus Work Artifact Harness. Use for presentation and other document, PDF, spreadsheet, data, image, archive, OCR, or media requests only when the mounted profile registry exposes that format. The current P0 profile creates new PPTX presentations with adapter-input isolation; it does not claim an operating-system network sandbox, edit existing presentations, or provide DOCX, XLSX, PDF, OCR, archive, image, data, or media production yet.

entries.name: Advanced
entries.description: Built-in advanced software delivery team with capability-matched Requirements-to-Architect traceability, execution, testing, interface, and independent-review frontiers.

entries.name: Base
entries.description: Compact outcome delivery through capability-matched execution and independent verification; planning and parallel research only when needed.

entries.name: Research Studio
entries.description: A research planning, durable evidence collection, reproducible analysis, post-computation fact-checking, and template-driven report-delivery squad.

entries.name: Generate Expert Squads
entries.description: Evidence-led heterogeneous algorithm import and canonical generation of project-owned, traceable OpenCorvus Expert Squads with independent contract review.

mission_skills.name: general
mission_skills.description: Coordinate an operator-defined Mission through native Mission state and fixed-profile Tasks without imposing a domain-specific workflow.
